initial_independent_grade.key_roof_finding: Official image shows shallow white ring-like rooftop room on tall brick tower; prior model had a green tiered dome over a tall drum on the lower classroom wing.

model_changes.footprint: Preserved existing structural shell and manifest origin; no structural wall dimensions or transforms changed. Prior independent assessment found bounding dimensions within 0.29 m but did not demonstrate vertex-by-vertex GIS registration. The detailed curved south frontage remains unverified.
model_changes.roof: Removed unsupported lower-wing brick drum, green copper-tiered dome, finial, repeated rings, and associated observatory furnishings. Added shallow white annular glazed room, white vertical piers, and flat crown on the center of the existing tall office-tower roof; location and dimensions are interpreted from oblique photograph and existing tower geometry, not surveyed. The first repair run removed 135 legacy BRNG_Rotunda_/BRNG_Vision21_ objects; an idempotence rerun removed the 103 generated room/facade objects and recreated the same 103-object repair set.
model_changes.facade: Added five vertical two-level glazed bays with mullions on the long west-facing classroom-wing elevation as a qualitative interpretation of the official oblique photo; cardinal registration of that image is not proven. Other elevations and exact entrance geometry remain partly unverified.
model_changes.height_and_floors: Preserved former model top elevation (29.70m) and main shell. GIS reports NUM_LEVELS=9, but total story arrangement, roof datum, and actual height are unverified. No assertion treats 38 or 95.1 as meters.
model_changes.export: Expected modular collection and local frame retained. New camera/lights/ground plane are placed in Beering_Preview_Setup and excluded from Asset_beering_hall.

uncertainties: No authoritative total height or measured elevation found.
GIS R=95.1 and Extrution=38 lack documented units/definitions.
Photo supports a white rooftop room on the tall tower, but exact position/dimensions are not measured.
Exact plan vertex fit and curving facade geometry are not yet verified against the entire GIS ring.
Story count: GIS field reports nine; accessible external evidence does not independently confirm the complete floor arrangement.

plan_geometry_comparison.status: Preserved existing wall placement/shape; prior independent review measured an approximate envelope match, while detailed curved frontage and wall-by-wall vertex fit remain unverified.
